patthana8.14:1.1: no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo ca na noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.14:3.1: noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. saṅkhittaṃ. no āsavañca na noāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: no āsavañca na noāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo ca na noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.14:4.1: hetuyā nava ārammaṇe nava avigate nava sabbattha vitthāro. na sāsavadukaṃ
